episode_title: Episode 920: El-Sayed Plays the Islamophobia Card
question: Who wins the Michigan Senate race in 2026
quote: I'm going to go higher than you guys for El-Sayed. I'm going to say 57%.
turn_text: Yeah, you know, a Republican operative who's close to this race was telling me exactly the same thing about a month ago. That's his theory. And if you look at the polling, Rogers hasn't led, I don't believe, in a public poll. But you look at last five or six, and it's El-Sayed ahead by one or two. So the slightest polling error here in El-Sayed's direction could put Rogers over the top. I'm going to go higher than you guys for El-Sayed. I'm going to say 57%. I think you've got to favor him, Democratic candidate, and a blue state in a blue year. But 43% things happen all the time. So I'm not by any means counting out Rogers. I think Rogers is a solid candidate. I don't think he's fantastic. I don't think he's particularly dynamic. But he's solid and unobjectionable. And if El-Sayed loses, there's either a polling error, and maybe the reason is the one that Andrew was talking about there, or as Noah referred to and Phil to, the undertow. You know, there could be an undertow among black voters, maybe among union voters. And if this close, that could be enough to put Rogers over the top. And arguably, this is the most important Senate race in the country, ideologically enormously important. This is the most radical Senate candidate we've ever seen. And Abdul El-Sayed, it would just be wonderful, marvelous to defeat him. And it makes the map so much harder for Democrats. We're going to get the Senate map in a segment. Was someone else trying to get in real quick?
host_quote: With that, next question to you, Noah Rothman, percentage odds that Abdul El-Sayed wins the Michigan Senate race in about two weeks from zero to 100?
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Michigan US Senate general election. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
outcome_source_title: AP: Progressive Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate race
